$comment: Row shape: {id, screen, setup?: [rowIds], steps: [{op, target?, text?, key?, ticks?, ms?}], marker, expect: [string], forbid?: [string], selectsNonEmpty?: [selectName], manual?: reason, notes}. Generated docs/testing/ui-smoke-inventory.md is rendered FROM this file by render-inventory.mjs -- edit this file, not the doc. Names in `target`/`selectsNonEmpty` are matched against the live uiProbe.ts snapshot's targets/selects by exact `name` (trimmed textContent || aria-label || placeholder || title || id, and select#<n> for the handful of anonymous <select>s -- see uiProbe.ts). Global forbid strings (applied by run.mjs to every row, not repeated here): 'could be read from the corpus', 'failure', 'Failed to load', 'requires the desktop runtime', 'undefined', 'NaN', '[object Object]', and 'Loading' still present after the row's wait budget.

DurabilityPanel lives inside DefenseTab. Both buttons are disabled until the 'amount' input holds a positive number, so a bare click (no type step first) would silently no-op -- this row damages then heals the same amount back so a repeated unattended run is net-zero on HP.

MoneyPanel lives inside the Gear tab, not a standalone tab of its own. Same disabled-until-typed constraint as HP; this row adds then spends the same 1gp back for a net-zero unattended run. The Gear tab also has its own unrelated 'Add' buttons (Add Armor/Add Gear) -- MoneyPanel's plain 'Add' is only unambiguous while no ItemPickerModal is open, which sheet-action-add-armor-gear-picker's own Escape guarantees by the time this row's reset-to-landing/setup chain re-runs it independently.
'Trait to add' select plus an 'Add' confirm button. Only rendered when `available.length > 0`, i.e. the character has an un-taken trait remaining -- honest-empty otherwise.
